Sphera Funds Management Ltd sold 100,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.99% with the market. The institutional investor held 50,000 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.12 million, down from 150,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sphera Funds Management Ltd who had been investing in Mylan N V (Call) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $20.42 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.05% or $0.42 during the last trading session, reaching $39.66. About 3.63M shares traded. Mylan N.V. (NASDAQ:MYL) has declined 5.23% since May 19, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 16.78% the S&P500.
